name: Shaman
body:
You serve as your tribe’s shaman, and are an intermediary between the tribe and your deity.

Prerequisite: Ability to cast divine spells

Benefit: Once per week you are able to meditate and enter a dream-state that allows you to communicate with your deity and his or her servants. This communication functions as a commune with nature spell.

The Book of Divine Magic. Copyright 2009, 4 Winds Fantasy Gaming; Authors Connie J. Thomson and Robert W. Thomson, with Katheryn Bauer and Sean O’Connor.
